guiding_principle: 1.1.25 the breadth multiplier. SLICE FIRST = teacher's OWN uploads (copyright_status=teacher_owned, no clearance gate); shared corpus is a later slice. Retrieval = ADK RAG (managed), NOT pgvector. ACL deny-by-default: teachers browse shared+own; the student tutor retrieves ONLY the running activity's cited materials, never the open corpus.
verified_api_2026_06_11: google.adk.tools.retrieval.VertexAiRagRetrieval (+ BaseRetrievalTool) is the agent tool. vertexai.rag provides RagCorpus + RagManagedDb (managed vector store, no pgvector) + RagFile + RagResource + RagRetrievalConfig + Filter. ailang_parse (docparse) available for the parse step. So provision a RagManagedDb-backed RagCorpus, ingest docparse text as RagFiles tagged {level,topic,owner_scope,doc_id}, retrieve via VertexAiRagRetrieval scoped by RagResource+Filter.

features.description: Backend RAG ingestion (Vertex infra). Provision a RagManagedDb RagCorpus (bootstrap + NOTES side-effect record). POST /api/curriculum/ingest: docparse (ailang_parse) -> text -> import into the corpus as a RagFile tagged {level,topic,owner_scope,doc_id} + write CurriculumDoc metadata. Teacher uploads = teacher_owned (un-gated); shared ingestion refuses copyright_status=pending.

Backend retrieval + tutor grounding. Student deny-by-default (only cited docs). Retrieval returns origin for citation.
